title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: With the E.H. Little Library undergoing major renovations, Davidson students have pivoted to a mix of historic halls, modern science hubs, and interim library spaces across campus.

cards.title: The Interim Library Hub
cards.subtitle: Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Visit the main collaborative study space during library renovations. It features desktop computers, a laptop kiosk, and furniture repurposed from E.H. Little Library.
cards.short_summary: The primary collaborative study space and interim library location during the E.H. Little Library renovation.
cards.evidence_claim: Lilly Family Gallery is the main collaborative study space during the library renovation, equipped with desktop computers, a laptop kiosk, and library staff.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students during the academic year; CatCard required for after-hours entry.

cards.title: The Silent Study Sanctuary
cards.subtitle: Tomlinson Hall
cards.notes: Head to the basement for the campus's primary silent study area. It features traditional study carrels for focused, distraction-free work sessions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated silent study space located in the basement of Tomlinson Hall, featuring traditional library carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tomlinson Hall Basement Conference Room is the primary silent study space during the interim period, featuring reused study carrels from E.H. Little Library.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College

cards.title: The Collaborative Atrium
cards.subtitle: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center
cards.notes: Utilize the 400-seat forum and common areas for group projects. The open-concept design encourages interaction between science disciplines.
cards.short_summary: A modern, high-ceilinged atrium and forum space designed for collaborative study and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The 400-seat forum of the atrium provides a space for study and social interaction, with gathering spaces sprinkled along circulation paths.
cards.source_title: E. Craig Wall Jr. Academic Center - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically open late for students.

cards.title: The Cozy Music Nook
cards.subtitle: Sloan Music Center 101
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot among the scores and recordings. This space offers three group study alcoves that can be reserved for evening sessions.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library in the Sloan Music Center offering a quiet environment and reservable group study alcoves.
cards.evidence_claim: The Music Library serves as the primary quiet study space during construction and features three group study alcoves reservable after 5 p.m.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College

cards.title: The Historic Study Hall
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building, Second Floor
cards.notes: Study in one of the most iconic buildings on campus. This room serves as a library teaching space but is open for group study when not in use.
cards.short_summary: A historic room in the Chambers Building that functions as a flexible study space for students.
cards.evidence_claim: When not in use for library sessions, students are welcome to use the Baxter Davidson Room for group study.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. for student study use.

cards.title: The 24/7 Group Room
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building
cards.notes: Reserve this classroom for late-night group projects. It is one of the designated 24-hour reservable spaces during the library renovation.
cards.short_summary: A designated classroom in the Chambers Building available for 24/7 group study reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: Chambers classrooms 2130 and 2164 are available to reserve 24/7 for group study.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College

cards.title: The Drop-In Tech Spot
cards.subtitle: Chambers Building, Third Floor
cards.notes: Use the desktop computers for intensive tasks or find a spot for group study. This lab operates on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor computer lab in Chambers providing drop-in access to technology and group study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The computer lab in Classroom 3130 is available for drop-in computer use and group study on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Using The Library During Construction - Davidson College
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; building access hours apply.

cards.title: The Creative Studio
cards.subtitle: Katherine and Tom Belk Visual Arts Center
cards.notes: Work in a space surrounded by contemporary art. Students in VAC classes have extended late-night access to these specialized studio facilities.
cards.short_summary: Specialized studio and study spaces for art students, featuring a digital art lab and Visual Resource Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Students enrolled in classes in the Visual Arts Center have CatCard access to facilities from 6 a.m. to 2 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: CatCard access 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m. for enrolled students.

cards.title: The Lower Level Retreat
cards.subtitle: Sloan Music Center
cards.notes: Head to the lower level for a mix of vending areas and study tables. It's a practical spot for a quick study session between practice rounds.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge in the lower level of the music center equipped with study tables and vending machines.
cards.evidence_claim: The lower level of Sloan Music Center includes a student lounge with vending areas, lounge chairs, and study tables.

cards.title: The Science Hub
cards.subtitle: Baker-Watt Science Complex
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner in this 45,000-square-foot facility. It houses biology and psychology labs along with general classrooms used for study.
cards.short_summary: A major academic building in the science complex offering classrooms and support spaces for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The Watson Life Sciences Building houses general classrooms, laboratories, and support space for biology and psychology.
cards.access_notes: Building access hours apply; typically open for student use during the day.
